body:
## Problem
In `packages/preflight/lib/checks.mjs`, `checkBash()` calls `runCmd("echo", ["preflight-ok"])`, which spawns `/bin/echo` directly without a shell (`shell: false`), never exercising `sh` or `bash`.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. `checkBash` in `packages/preflight/lib/checks.mjs` invokes a shell via `runCmd("sh", ["-c", "echo preflight-ok"], { env })` (accepting an optional `env` override for testability) and reports failure if the shell exits non-zero or does not output `preflight-ok`. Verify: `node --test packages/preflight/test/unit.test.mjs`.
2. Existing preflight integration and empty-test-cmd suites pass unchanged. Verify: `node --test packages/preflight/test/integration.test.mjs packages/preflight/test/empty-test-cmd.test.mjs`.
title: fix(preflight): invoke sh -c in checkBash so the bash check exercises a real shell (#714)
